decisions.reason: The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine builds directly on the firm's core expertise in precast plant equipment and its own R&D, so management can read early results and refine it, although the quick removal of the 2023 robots shows the firm does prune or rename its machine offers readily.

The production analysis software fits the firm's in-house control and software capabilities and supports its strategy of automated, data-driven lifecycle offers, so it is easy to assimilate and improve and cheap to keep on the market.
